replacement_direct_source.title: Dell Technologies Accelerates Enterprise AI Innovation from PC to Data Center with NVIDIA

token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Bind the failed Dell newsroom route to the same issuer's official investor-relations PDF while reusing every successful immutable R1 capture.
token_budget_basis.input_scale_basis: One failed R1 locator, one reviewed official replacement locator and four digest-bound reusable captures; no provider discovery, generation or learned-ranking call.
required_outputs: one capture-before-parse request and response or typed failure
candidate-only issuer source object and proposition proposals
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: The successor must prove exactly one retired failed URL, one fresh official issuer URL, four unchanged captures, publication date, speaker identity, source class and candidate-only authority.
token_budget_basis.materiality_and_quality_risk: A mirrored press release could be mistaken for new independent evidence, or Dell product availability could be mislabeled as private NVIDIA allocation, Dell units or profit authority.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: R1 preserved one Dell newsroom HTTP 403 while four other direct originals succeeded; the official investor-relations PDF exposes the same March 18, 2025 issuer release on an accessible Dell-controlled host.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Deterministic AI-free predecessor validation, immutable capture reuse, one exact-once official PDF fetch, parse and candidate compilation.
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Execute only the one replacement route with no retry; abort if the predecessor binding, four-route reuse count, one-route delta or issuer identity changes; preserve any new failure and do not infer allocation, units, ASP or gap closure.
